system.description:
• Effect: A new Channel option, used as your action: as the Cleric's Turn Undead, but counting as a Cleric 2 levels lower than your Paladin level. The Turn DC is your Class Save DC, using Charisma.
  • A 3rd level Paladin turns as a 1st level Cleric, a 5th level Paladin as a 3rd level Cleric, and so on
  • Destruction applies from 8th effective turning level, if the undead's Level is no more than half that level
